summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of an application that categorizes and displays different types of wishes. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Tabs for Categories**: At the top, there are three tabs labeled "SMS," "Jokes," and "Videos," indicating different categories of content that users can switch between.
2. **List of Wishes**: Under the "SMS" tab, a list of various wish messages is displayed. Each wish has a title and a corresponding number indicating the count or popularity of that wish. The wishes listed include:
   - Good Morning (710)
   - Good Day (560)
   - Good Night (347)
   - Nice Weekend (135)
   - Best of Luck (39)
   - Congratulations for Board Exams (6)
   - Get Well Soon (8)
   - Good Evening (4)
